rv.q: Music Theater Works’ production of an American musical classic may be their finest show to date.

Fortunately, Music Theater Works’ new production of “West Side Story” goes big in every way, with tremendous singers and actors, fabulous costumes, explosive choreography and a nimble twenty-two-piece orchestra, conducted by Justin Kono.
The entire ensemble of Jets and Sharks brought a creative energy and verve to a piece that demands it in every musical note.
Why is director Sasha Gerritson's excellent production only running for two and a half weeks? Here's hoping for an extension.
Music Theater Works’ production of West Side Story succeeds through its energy, vocal performances, and character development.
Music Theater Works ’ “West Side Story” is definitely in the latter category.
I must say, the choreography is "stunning".
Overall, this is an enjoyable, solid production in a great venue with strong musical and dance performances all around.

cn.t: Music Theater Works delivers a stellar revival of this Broadway classic, with critics praising the explosive choreography, tremendous vocal performances, and majestic scope that does justice to Bernstein and Sondheim's enduring masterpiece.
